category.basic.meaning: Localized ability category, no claim all characters have a trait.

category.automatic.meaning: Localized ability category, no claim all characters have a trait.

category.manual.meaning: Localized ability category, no claim all characters have a trait.

category.support.meaning: Localized ability category, no claim all characters have a trait.

category.trait.meaning: Localized ability category, no claim all characters have a trait.

shape.SWEEP.meaning: Qualitative shape/role only; do not output engine distance units.

shape.THRUST.meaning: Qualitative shape/role only; do not output engine distance units.

shape.PROJECTILE.meaning: Qualitative shape/role only; do not output engine distance units.

shape.NOVA.meaning: Qualitative shape/role only; do not output engine distance units.

shape.HEAL.meaning: Qualitative shape/role only; do not output engine distance units.

shape.MANA.meaning: Qualitative shape/role only; do not output engine distance units.

shape.WARD.meaning: Qualitative shape/role only; do not output engine distance units.

scope.active.meaning: Actual beneficiary scope; party means living assigned members.

scope.self.meaning: Actual beneficiary scope; party means living assigned members.

scope.party.meaning: Actual beneficiary scope; party means living assigned members.

scope.lowest_hp.meaning: Actual beneficiary scope; party means living assigned members.

scope.lowest_mp.meaning: Actual beneficiary scope; party means living assigned members.

trigger.basic.meaning: Current controlled character automatically attacks eligible targets.

trigger.automatic.meaning: Current controlled character automatically attempts this skill after unlock/cooldown.

trigger.manual.meaning: Explicit key activation; success requires level, MP, cooldown and target where required.

trigger.support.meaning: Assigned alive off-field character periodically attempts support, free MP.

trigger.mark.meaning: Off-field support attempts after this many real foreground basic hits; actual support cooldown, not unused trait interval.

trigger.ammo.meaning: Off-field support reacts to foreground direct hits, bounded by actual support cooldown.

trigger.trait.meaning: Additional passive rules, not a separately pressed skill.

fact.damage.meaning: Base percentage of caster attack, not guaranteed HP loss.

fact.heal.meaning: Healing amount includes source level formula, subject to max HP.

fact.mana.meaning: MP restoration subject to recipient max MP.

fact.shield.meaning: Shield amount and total recipient HP-based shield cap.

fact.cooldown.meaning: Cooldown or base attack interval in seconds.

fact.cost.meaning: Nominal or current manual MP cost supplied by projection.

fact.range.meaning: Qualitative shape; no naked world-unit distances.

fact.echo_record.meaning: First layer: latest paid concrete spell replaces record, with charges and lifetime only. Strength scaling remains in expanded detail.echo_record_strength.

condition.echo_record.meaning: Off-field alive owner, another living teammate actually pays for successful manual skill; consumes one charge.

detail.echo_record_snapshot.meaning: Snapshot original prepared cast damage at recording, not current attack and not original enemy HP loss; original spell shape.

detail.echo_record_secondary.meaning: No original accessory/spark/paid recursion; aim/origin chosen at replay time.

fact.expose.meaning: Vulnerability applied to surviving hit targets after damage.

detail.expose.meaning: Same class strongest multiplier, not additive.

fact.guard.meaning: Finite guard lifetime, hostile-hit charges, reduction and counter scale.

condition.guard.meaning: Absorbed hostile hit can consume guard; owner and recipient need not be same.

detail.guard.meaning: Counter uses guard caster snapshot; no recursive hit/counter chain.

fact.party_heal.meaning: Per-recipient overheal becomes own shield capped by own max HP.

condition.party_heal.meaning: Living assigned recipients only; never resurrects.

condition.refund_settle.meaning: Settle remaining accounts owned by this character; no fresh refund copied; pays own cost/CD.

fact.curse.meaning: Additional total curse damage from caster attack across duration, not damage every tick.

detail.curse.meaning: Same source refreshes, does not stack without bound.

fact.curse_spread.meaning: Copies bounded fraction of pre-existing remaining curses to up to count nearby enemies.

condition.curse_spread.meaning: Requires pre-existing curse; no recursive spread.

fact.curse_cashout.meaning: Settles/removes this fraction of existing remaining curse pool.

condition.curse_cashout.meaning: Base attack remains available without a curse.

fact.ammo_volley.meaning: Spends up to count arrows; each increases this strike damage by percent.

condition.ammo_volley.meaning: Zero arrows retains base volley; MP/cooldown still required.

fact.ammo_followup.meaning: One special arrow if available; otherwise this percentage of ordinary support damage.

detail.ammo_followup.meaning: No current foreground accessory and no recursive direct hit trigger.

fact.shield_strike.meaning: Consumes at most amount own shield, each point increases this strike damage by percent.

condition.shield_strike.meaning: Zero shield retains base attack; more shield also broadens reach, no engine units.

fact.temper.meaning: Direct attacks gain reach and bounded secondary spark; spark percent of temper caster snapshot attack.

detail.temper.meaning: Only direct foreground attacks; no support inheritance; spark does not retrigger hits.

fact.extend.meaning: Extends other living teammates active echo/temper windows, total extension capped per instance.

condition.extend.meaning: Does not add charges, revive expired effects, extend self, or create a fresh window.

fact.rally.meaning: Attack damage and basic attack speed buff, duration and recipient scope.

detail.rally.meaning: Same class strongest, no additive stacking.

condition.dash_forward.meaning: Advance along auto-aim direction; qualitative movement only.

condition.dash_back.meaning: Retreat opposite auto-aim direction; qualitative movement only.

fact.field.meaning: Placed area lifetime, pulse interval and damage percentage of caster snapshot.

fact.field_heal.meaning: Per pulse heal to qualifying recipients within the area.

fact.field_mana.meaning: Per pulse mana to qualifying recipients within the area.

detail.field.meaning: Origin stays at deployment for current kits; source attribution/snapshot retained after leaving foreground; no paid recursion.

trait.echo.fact.meaning: First layer: latest paid concrete spell replaces record, with charges and lifetime only. Strength scaling remains in expanded detail.echo_record_strength.

trait.echo.condition.meaning: Latest successful paid J/K replaces record; owner must be off field and alive for teammate actual paid trigger.

trait.echo.detail.meaning: Snapshot damage, diminished slow, no accessory/paid recursion.

trait.mark.fact.meaning: Count threshold and actual support cooldown.

trait.mark.condition.meaning: Off-field/alive; actual foreground basic hit; count capped, failed CD attempt retains count until later valid hit.

trait.mark.detail.meaning: One cast hitting multiple targets is deduplicated; support/secondary hits do not build it.

trait.ammo.fact.meaning: Capacity, initial arrows, timed refill, teammate paid refill and actual support cooldown.

trait.ammo.condition.meaning: Foreground basic does not spend arrows; off-field direct-hit follow-up spends at most one; no arrows has fallback.

trait.ammo.detail.meaning: Teammate refill requires successful actual MP payment, no secondary recursion.

trait.refund.fact.meaning: Fraction of other teammate actual MP payment refunded to original payer over timed installments.

trait.refund.condition.meaning: Owner must be living assigned off-field; refund is not a fresh paid cast.

trait.refund.detail.meaning: Settlement only pays the outstanding balance, never copies it.

trait.relay.fact.meaning: Different previous/current successful payer gets discount; actual minimum cost.

trait.relay.condition.meaning: Only successful actual paid manual casts update payer; switching and same payer do not qualify.

trait.relay.detail.meaning: Living assigned provider, strongest provider discount; no secondary trigger.

trait.curse.fact.meaning: Own direct nonmanual attacks apply bounded total curse damage, with interval.

trait.curse.condition.meaning: Not every hit; surviving targets, same-source refresh, no secondary recursion.

trait.curse.detail.meaning: Configured passive curse is separate from manual curse mechanics.

missing.summary.meaning: Clearly no skill equipped; not a locked future skill.

state.missing.meaning: Reason for current manual availability; paused is separate boolean and does not mask reason.

state.dead.meaning: Reason for current manual availability; paused is separate boolean and does not mask reason.

state.locked.meaning: Reason for current manual availability; paused is separate boolean and does not mask reason.

state.ended.meaning: Reason for current manual availability; paused is separate boolean and does not mask reason.

state.inactive.meaning: Reason for current manual availability; paused is separate boolean and does not mask reason.

state.cooldown.meaning: Reason for current manual availability; paused is separate boolean and does not mask reason.

state.mana.meaning: Reason for current manual availability; paused is separate boolean and does not mask reason.

state.no_target.meaning: Reason for current manual availability; paused is separate boolean and does not mask reason.

state.ready.meaning: Reason for current manual availability; paused is separate boolean and does not mask reason.

detail.shape.SWEEP.meaning: Auto-aim toward eligible target, broad forward area can hit multiple; not manual aim.

detail.shape.THRUST.meaning: Auto-aim toward eligible target, all eligible enemies within narrow forward line; no target fails before cost/CD.

detail.shape.PROJECTILE.meaning: Actual travelling projectile resolves on contact; selected target is not guaranteed hit; eligible target required at cast.

detail.shape.NOVA.meaning: Around cast origin, may activate without enemies; cannot promise a target was hit.

detail.shape.HEAL.meaning: Living recipients only, max HP cap; source level determines healing increment.

detail.shape.MANA.meaning: Restores to living recipients with max MP cap, no resource duplication.

detail.shape.WARD.meaning: Total shield cap per recipient, no resurrection.

trait.echo.summary.meaning: Non-numeric concise description of this extra passive rule; facts retain all numeric rules. Do not duplicate the fact string.

trait.mark.summary.meaning: Non-numeric concise description of this extra passive rule; facts retain all numeric rules. Do not duplicate the fact string.
